name: OpenCode
description: Installs the OpenCode v2 CLI, seeds ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json, and ships helper scripts for working with the config.

configTemplate.description: JSON content written to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json when the file is missing.

installHelperScripts.description: Installs the opencode-template helper alongside the main CLI.

opencodeVersion.description: Version of the OpenCode CLI to install (e.g. 2.1.2). Defaults to the latest release.
